svg.text: FIT · PART 2.0 — ENERGY SYSTEMS & THE AEROBIC BASE
2 of 5 · THE ENGINE · floor before ceiling

text.tspan: Your fitness is the usable space between a floor you can raise for years
and a ceiling that barely moves. The room grows from the bottom up.

svg.text: a sports car with a 2-litre tank.
THE ZONE MAP — find the operating band
all-out — the 20% hard work lives up here
hard but sustainable — the lactate edge
too hard to recover, too easy to adapt — avoid
the operating band — this builds the floor
walking / flush — easy days stay easy
POLARIZED 80 / 20 — easy easy, hard hard, nothing in between
the struck-out middle (Z3) is where most people accidentally live
THE FUEL MIX — three systems, always on, the blend shifts with duration
All three always on — anaerobic = the sprint budget · aerobic = the salary that refills it.
· cheap to recover — stacks with lifting
⚠ high cost — rations against strength gains
⚠ INTERFERENCE COST — interval recovery competes with lifting. Ration the hard work; the floor is what compounds. → see Part 4.0
IS THE ENGINE GROWING? — read the convergence, not one heroic stat
HR stays flat through the run
ZONE 2 BY FEEL: full sentences · easy nasal breathing · MAF 180−age — it should feel embarrassingly easy
Track the trend, not the day. Sources: Seiler (80/20) · Helgerud 2007 (4×4) · Maffetone (180−age) · Karvonen 1957 (HR zones).
